scope: Generated cells, edges, zones, pillars and keys for a square of chunks per seed. Geometry, rendering and human playability are separate.

exits.scope: Per seed, floors 1..n: floor 1 from the title's start area where the game puts it (RootFor), later floors from the previous EXIT cell (SeedFor, a 1-cell start area). Checks the planner's EXIT against the rules again with the validator's own walks. Data only: no geometry, no MapWorld.
